correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the source definitions, normalization, Fourier decomposition and exact deficit splitting. It treats arbitrary nearby admissible functions, not only the source test family. A bounded normalized deficit forces high-frequency excess Q(z)=O(d^4); after z=d^2 w, the exact fourth-order problem is a positive quadratic completion against the second harmonic, whose squared norm is 1/2 and excess eigenvalue is q_n or 1. The scalar remainder contributes 1/4 by its fourth-order Taylor expansion. The source family realizes equality. Finite numerical evaluations were used only as sanity checks, not as proof.
